_design_note: Neutral operator/policy descriptions — no gate names, no threshold values in candidate texts. PSE horizon tags (spec_policy, spec_outcome, causal_gate, cone_gate, visibility_gate, tension_gate, duality_gate, wrong_gate) are the only reliable discriminator. The four HorizonFailurePolicy names (WaitForHorizon, RefineProjectionCone, MigrateCarrier, Recondense) each sound plausible for any failure — the spec table maps each to exactly one failing gate.

cases.title: G_causal failure — declared vs observed carrier order mismatch, which policy and outcome apply?

horizon_context.description: HorizonCrossingGate failed on G_causal. CausalAdmissibilityReport has 2 violations: observed phase ray emission order does not match the declared carrier lex-order. g_visible, g_cone, g_dual all passed. Tension and attenuation within bounds. Failure policy is determined by the spec table — G_causal failure maps to exactly one policy variant.

events.message: select_failure_policy(g_visible=true, g_cone=true, g_causal=false, g_dual=true, tension_ok=true, attn_ok=true) -> failure policy selected per spec table
selected failure policy maps to corresponding HorizonV3Outcome variant

candidates.text: Horizon outcome variant that holds the current pipeline state and emits a diagnostic hold report indicating the crossing cannot proceed.
Failure policy that initiates alternative carrier selection from the configured phase ladder. Promotes a different slot to re-establish the required phase ordering for the next crossing attempt.
Reads the violations list from the causal admissibility report. Identifies the carrier and ray entries involved in the reported discrepancy.
Failure policy that adjusts phase field projection geometry parameters toward their configured bounds.
candidates._trap: RefineProjectionCone is the spec policy for G_cone failure. g_cone passed — wrong gate.

candidates.text: Failure policy that holds the pipeline at the current chart state until an admissible phase epoch becomes available.
candidates._trap: WaitForHorizon applies when only g_visible fails. g_visible passed here — wrong gate. The name suggests a universally valid waiting strategy.

candidates.text: Failure policy that triggers a carrier phase recondensation cycle on the current chart epoch.
candidates._trap: Recondense applies when tension_ok or attenuation_ok fails, or when g_dual fails. All passed — wrong gate.

candidates.text: Re-evaluates the cone focus score by computing the angular deviation from the configured projection axis. Returns a revised ProjectionConeReport for the current chart state.
Verifies that the collapse and emission paths both resolve back to the same NullCenter. Computes the duality score and emits a DualityReport with pass/fail and evidence hash.
Failure policy that terminates the current horizon pipeline run without emitting any hold report. Returns a hard failure diagnostic to the caller.
Constructs a HorizonChart by unfolding the NullCenter into a hypertoroidal phase space. Assigns carriers, rays, cones and causal order for a new chart epoch.

correct_next_actions: NeedsCarrierMigration outcome (spec outcome for G_causal failure)

cases.title: G_visible failure only — which policy, outcome, and diagnostic action are correct?

horizon_context.description: HorizonCrossingGate failed on G_visible only. All other sub-gates passed: g_cone, g_causal, g_dual, tension, attenuation. No EventHorizonWindowV3 passed the phase/epoch/amplitude/jitter visibility check. The spec table maps this exact pattern (only g_visible false, all others true) to WaitForHorizon.

events.message: select_failure_policy(g_visible=false, g_cone=true, g_causal=true, g_dual=true, tension_ok=true, attn_ok=true) -> WaitForHorizon

candidates.text: Horizon outcome variant that holds the current chart and emits a hold report. The pipeline resumes when a phase window opens that satisfies the minimum visibility threshold for at least one EventHorizonWindowV3.
Failure policy selected when the visibility gate is the sole failing sub-gate. Instructs the caller to hold the chart epoch and retry at the next phase window opening.

Re-evaluates all EventHorizonWindowV3 entries against the current phase ray positions, amplitude bounds and jitter thresholds. Identifies which window parameters are preventing visibility gate passage.
Failure policy that adjusts the projection cone angle and focus parameters toward the configured bounds. Reduces cone dispersion to bring the focus score within the required range.
candidates._trap: RefineProjectionCone applies when g_cone fails. g_cone passed — wrong gate. The name suggests a geometry fix.

candidates.text: Failure policy that promotes an alternative phase-ladder slot to restore the emission order for the next crossing attempt.
candidates._trap: MigrateCarrier applies when g_causal fails. g_causal passed — wrong gate.

candidates.text: Failure policy that triggers carrier phase recondensation to reduce boundary tension and signal attenuation in the phase field.
candidates._trap: Recondense applies when tension_ok or attenuation_ok or g_dual fails. All three passed — wrong gate.

candidates.text: Verifies that the collapse and emission paths both resolve back to the same NullCenter. Returns a DualityReport with pass/fail verdict.
Reads the carrier order violations from the CausalAdmissibilityReport and compares declared vs observed sequence hashes.
Failure policy that terminates the current horizon pipeline run without emitting a hold report. Returns a hard failure diagnostic.
Attaches computed PhaseRays to the HorizonChart structure. Assigns deterministic ray identifiers and sorts the ray list before hashing.

correct_next_actions: WaitForHorizon outcome (spec outcome when only g_visible fails)
evaluate_horizon_windows (diagnose why visibility threshold is not met)

cases.title: G_dual failure — which policy applies, and which Recondense variant is spec-correct?

horizon_context.description: HorizonCrossingGate failed on G_dual only. g_visible, g_cone, g_causal all passed. Tension and attenuation within bounds. The DualityReport shows the collapse path and emission path resolve to different NullCenter projections — a duality coupling mismatch. The spec table maps !g_dual (with tension_ok and attenuation_ok passing) to Recondense. Name-trap: one candidate correctly names Recondense but describes it as addressing tension damping — the wrong sub-cause. The correct Recondense variant addresses null-center coupling realignment, not tension.

events.message: select_failure_policy(g_visible=true, g_cone=true, g_causal=true, g_dual=false, tension_ok=true, attn_ok=true) -> Recondense

candidates.text: Horizon outcome variant that holds the current chart epoch and emits a hold report recommending carrier phase recondensation to realign the duality coupling between the collapse and emission paths.

Failure policy triggering carrier phase recondensation to realign the null-center projection of the collapse path with the emission path. Addresses the duality coupling mismatch reported in the DualityReport.
Reads the DualityReport to identify which carrier's collapse path diverges from the emission path's NullCenter projection. Computes the coupling distance and identifies the misaligned carrier.

Recondensation policy variant that reduces accumulated boundary tension and signal attenuation by compressing the phase field along the carrier axis. Restores tension and attenuation to within nominal bounds.
candidates._trap: Recondense is the correct policy name — but this variant addresses tension damping, not null-center duality coupling. Tension_ok and attenuation_ok both passed. Applying the tension-variant of Recondense does not resolve a duality coupling mismatch. The spec-correct Recondense here targets the collapse/emission path realignment.

candidates.text: Failure policy that promotes an alternative phase-ladder slot to restore the correct emission order for the next crossing attempt.
candidates._trap: MigrateCarrier applies when g_causal fails. g_causal passed — wrong gate. The word 'dual' might suggest carrier switching, but carrier migration addresses ordering, not null-center coupling.

candidates.text: Failure policy that holds the chart epoch until a phase window opens satisfying the minimum visibility threshold.
candidates._trap: WaitForHorizon applies when g_visible fails. g_visible passed — wrong gate.

candidates.text: Failure policy that adjusts cone angle and focus parameters to bring the cone focus score within the required range.
Re-evaluates the cone focus score by computing the angular deviation from the configured projection axis.
Reads the carrier order violations from the CausalAdmissibilityReport and compares declared vs observed sequence hashes.
Failure policy that terminates the horizon pipeline run without emitting a hold report.
